SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.ACTIVATEDFLAG, B.TESTCATEGORYID, B.TESTID, B.METHODID, F.TESTNAME, C.METHODNAME, C .TESTMETHODBASIS, C.METHODNO, C.SOURCE, E.ORGNAME, B.METHODPARAM, B.CONROLLEDNO, B.DISPLAYMONITORBASIS, B.AUTHENTICATION, B.APPROVAL, B.ANALYSISRECORDNAME, B.ANALYSISFEE, B.SAMPLEFEE, B.HOURS, B.DEFAULTFLAG, B.TESTENGLISHNAME, B.INPUTUSERNAME, B.RECOVERYRATE, B.BEFOREHANDLE, B.REMARK FROM T_EMC_TEST_CAPACITY A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD B ON A.TESTMETHODID=B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD C ON B.METHODID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG E ON B.ANALYSISORGID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST F ON B.TESTID = F.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
